description: This file contains unit tests for the TaskDao component within an Android application using Room database. It verifies CRUD operations, observation of task lists, and update behaviors specifically for the TaskDao interface implementations.

classes.name: test_TaskDao
classes.description: Test class for TaskDao, containing multiple unit tests to verify data operations and behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database and DAO before each test.

methods.name: insert and getById returns entity
methods.description: Tests insertion of a TaskEntity and retrieval by ID.

methods.name: update persists change
methods.description: Verifies that updates to an entity are persisted correctly.

methods.name: delete removes row
methods.description: Checks that delete operation removes a task and reduces count.

methods.name: observeAll returns incomplete first then updatedAt desc
methods.description: Ensures observing all tasks returns them sorted with incomplete tasks first, ordered by updatedAt descending.

methods.name: toggle complete via update changes ordering
methods.description: Tests toggling task completion and verifies list ordering updates accordingly.
